summary: Deliver a checkable inventory reservation service: authorized callers hold stock for a TTL, release or expire holds without double-booking, with named domain errors for insufficient stock and unauthorized callers—without payments, multi-warehouse routing, or a full IAM product.
goal: Authorized principals can reserve and release inventory units against SKUs with soft holds; unauthorized or insufficient-stock attempts fail with named domain errors; holds expire after TTL.
background: Framing example for solid_sdd hardening (intake/brief/critique/gates). No prior Features in this sample repo; treat as greenfield for this change_id.

in_scope.text: WHEN an authorized caller requests a reservation for a SKU and quantity THEN THE inventory service SHALL create a soft hold that reduces available stock for the hold TTL
IF available stock is less than the requested quantity THEN THE inventory service SHALL fail with a named domain error and create no hold
IF the caller is not authorized for the SKU THEN THE inventory service SHALL fail with a named domain error and create no hold
WHEN an authorized caller releases an active hold THEN THE inventory service SHALL restore the held quantity to available stock
WHILE a hold is past its TTL THE inventory service SHALL treat the hold as expired and restore availability (lazily or via explicit expire)
THE inventory service SHALL expose reservation/release behaviors on a checkable HTTP/API surface
THE inventory service SHALL provide module-level contracts that make hold invariants checkable

out_of_scope.text: Payment capture, checkout, or order fulfillment
Multi-warehouse routing, transfers, or location-level ATP beyond a single stock pool per SKU
Full IAM product (SSO, roles UI, OAuth provider); only opaque principal authorization checks
UI clients, notifications, or analytics products
Partial shipment / backorder policies beyond hard fail when available stock is below the requested quantity

assumptions: One stock pool per SKU (available + held)
Caller presents a principal id the service can authorize against a simple allow-list or policy stub
TTL is a positive duration configured per reservation request or service default
constraints: Do not invent payment or multi-warehouse features
Unauthorized and insufficient-stock failures must be named and distinguishable
ChangeBrief only at brief emission; Features/WorkPlan follow decompose

success_criteria.text: Authorized reserve when available stock is at least the requested quantity creates a hold and reduces availability by the quantity
When available stock is below the requested quantity, and when the caller is unauthorized, each fails with a distinct named domain error and leaves stock unchanged
Release and TTL expiry restore held quantity to available stock
HTTP/API and module contracts make the above checkable without opaque internals alone

human_gate.reason: Inventory integrity and authorization boundary; confirm Brief before decompose.
